name: Odd Love Test
source:
The odd "Love test," a game to capture his heart... but dump him to win!?

Kay is a woman who never had a boyfriend before. Her best friend Rina always dumps her boyfriends after getting all the "love and money" and teases Kay for being a virgin for many years. Because Kay never had a boyfriend before, Rina always makes up games that has to do with Kay interacting with strangers... for her entertainment.

On a boring day when Kay and Rina meet at the park, Rina came up with the "love test," a game where you have to make a guy fall for you... and dump him! But if you really fall in love, you lose all of your money!?

Help Kay figure out what to do! Win a man's heart and dump him to get your money back, or lose all your money just to "fall in love!?"

[From [url=https://eeveetron.itch.io/odd-love-test]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奇怪的“恋爱测试”，一场俘获他心的游戏……但要获胜，必须甩掉他！？

凯从未交过男朋友。她最好的朋友莉娜总是在得到所有“爱情和金钱”后甩掉男友，还嘲笑凯多年保持处女。因为凯从未交过男朋友，莉娜总是设计各种让凯和陌生人互动的游戏，供自己娱乐。

某个无聊的日子，凯和莉娜在公园见面，莉娜提出“恋爱测试”：让一个男人爱上你……然后甩掉他！但如果你真的爱上他，就会输掉所有钱！？

帮助凯决定该怎么办！俘获男人的心，再甩掉他拿回钱；还是为了“坠入爱河”而失去所有钱！？

[来源：[url=https://eeveetron.itch.io/odd-love-test]Itch.io[/url]]
